messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate edges for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "has half life"
set: ["has half life", "has function", "has formulation", "has packaging", "has concentration", "has maximum dose", "has composition", "has generic name", "has product type", "has dosage form", "has effect duration", "has note", "has duration in system", "has tested dose", "has brand name", "has uncertainty"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the edges set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best edge name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the edges set
